pu.banner.title: New: plan update {date}
pu.banner.body: New research has been built into the rules of your plan. See what changes for you. Your plan stays exactly as it is until you choose.
pu.page.intro: This is what changes in your plan from today. Everything you have already done stays as it is.
pu.changes.title: What changes
pu.preview.title: Your next 4 weeks: before and after
pu.preview.none: Nothing changes in your next 4 weeks. The update only takes effect later in your plan.
pu.preview.unchanged: Days that stay the same are not shown.
pu.forecast.title: Forecast and chance
pu.apply.note: You can always undo this under Settings → Plan history.
pu.state.applied: Applied on {date}. This is your active version.
pu.state.dismissed: You chose “Not now”. Your plan is unchanged; you can still apply this update here.
pu.state.rolledBack: You applied this update and later went back. You can apply it again here.
pu.state.current: This update is already part of your plan.
pu.toast.applied: Plan update applied. Your plan is updated from today.
pu.toast.dismissed: OK, your plan stays as it is.
pu.toast.rolled: Back to version {n}. Your plan is updated from today.
pu.toast.error: That did not work. Your plan has not changed. Try again.
pu.hist.title: Plan history
pu.hist.intro: Every version of your plan rules since you started. You can go back to an earlier version at any time, as often as you like. What you have already done never changes.
pu.rb.title: Go back to version {n}?
pu.rb.body: This is how your next 4 weeks change. Nothing in the past changes.
pu.rb.same: Your next 4 weeks stay the same with this version.
pu.sci.levelNote: Level A to D shows how strong the evidence is (A is the strongest).
pu.admin.title: Plan updates
pu.admin.intro: Rule versions live in the code (src/engine/rules). Here you create a draft from a version, run the preview, and publish. Publishing sends no e-mail; members see a notice in the app.
pu.admin.makeDraft: Create draft from rule set v{v}
pu.admin.noVersions: There is no version newer than 1 in the code yet.
pu.admin.publishConfirm: Publish this update? Members on an older version will see it in the app.
pu.admin.noCode: This version is not in the code of this build.
